name: Cubature
nameStatus: Final fork name; GitHub repository orthrus-research/Cubature, a fork of OpenCubicChunks/CubicChunks
reason: Cubature owns cubic scheduling, lighting, lifetime, storage and DH runtime compatibility/optimization patches; Riven owns generated content
scope: Exact Cubature commit; compatibility IDs, APIs, packets and world formats retained.

qualification.status: Cubature 1.12.2-0.1.4.0, built for Cleanroom from a clean checkout of this commit; 298 Cubature tests and 80 lab tests, 0 failures. riven.ps1 full (every ci job and the native smoke capture) passed with this pin. Native runs of fresh Riven worlds with these bytes: a PREFETCH lifecycle flight-and-settle on cube-flight-lifecycle-v2 (every scenario passed; 14,858 unloads and no loads while standing, resting at the 20,538-cube floor) and a BASELINE land route with 8 DH workers and the LOD trace (every scenario passed; flight tick p95 44.2 ms against the 45 ms target, 763 tiles). The lab's lost full-view teleport stays open (Cubature docs/LOD-DELIVERY.md). Server logs show only what every earlier run shows: the missing MixinItemMap, duplicate furnace recipes, two unknown Biomes O' Plenty biome names and, in some runs, a connection reset as the client quits.
qualification.contents: Version 0.1.4.0 with Orthrus Research as copyright holder and vendor and compile-only build inputs that a standalone clone fetches; since the initial commit, the manual CI workflow's build-input step, deliveryMode as the only delivery input, the periodic autosave as a named provider call, explicit delivery generation timing with run-or-await for work in flight, sender-chosen PacketCubes sizing, a provider and lighting that reach the player cube map only through CubeDemand and SurfaceHeightListener, held teleports kept when a teleport leaves the player in place, PlayerCubeMap, CubeProviderServer and the lab's Python tools split into focused parts, the delivery system in its own core.server.delivery package behind a boundary test, every numeric setting ranged and checked on sync and by the set command, and every test source run on both loaders, every test source run on Cleanroom, the Java 8 Forge fallback retired, and a bounded build pool offered to the generator through ICubeGenerator.useBuildPool (generatorBuildThreads), and regional preparation ahead of the players through ICubeGenerator.prepareRegion (regionalPreparationReachBlocks) under a contention governor, held teleports kept through vanilla's corrections of a client's moves, and a held teleport that ends without completing logged with its cause, Distant Horizons previews held while the native view is behind, previews sampled on Cubature's own pool paced by the tick's tail (previewThreads), and Distant Horizons' block-state wrappers cached per preview tile.
limits: Respawn, portal and join arrivals still load their column synchronously
qualification.knownExistingWarning: Missing MixinItemMap remains; held-map behavior unqualified
